# Cformly

> The front desk's 24-hour register: an FRRO Form III (formerly Form C) filing assistant for Indian hotels, guest houses, and homestays.

Cformly helps hotel front desks register foreign guests with the FRRO
(Foreigners Regional Registration Office) within the legally required 24
hours. The mobile app scans the passport and visa with open-source OCR
running entirely on the device, shows every extracted field on one review
screen, and a free browser extension auto-fills the FRRO portal form inside
the host's own browser session. The human host always solves the CAPTCHA and
attaches the guest photo before submitting.

## Key facts

- Filing obligation: every accommodation hosting a foreign guest must report
  arrivals — and departures — within 24 hours (Immigration and Foreigners
  Act 2025, §8(1)); the form formerly called Form C is now Form III.
- Privacy: passports, visas, and guest photos are captured, read, and stored
  only on the hotel's phone (encrypted, SQLCipher). No document image or
  extracted field is ever uploaded to any server, including Cformly's.
  Compliant with India's DPDP Act 2023.
- OCR: open-source, on-device only. No third-party AI services.
- The browser extension works only on the official FRRO portal page the host
  has open, stores no credentials and no personal data, and never submits
  anything — CAPTCHA and photo stay with the host.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Punjabi,
  Marathi, Urdu, Bengali, Gujarati, and Assamese. Per-language pages exist
  under /hi/, /ta/, /te/, /ml/, /kn/, /pa/, /mr/, /ur/, /bn/, /gu/, /as/.
- Status: free, in invite-only testing with real front desks; App
  Store / Google Play listings are coming soon.
- Affiliation: Cformly is an independent filing assistant. It is not
  affiliated with or endorsed by the FRRO or the Government of India; the
  host remains legally responsible for accurate, timely filing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cformly.com/): product overview — how Cformly works, why it
  beats manual portal entry, privacy commitments, FAQ.
- [Setup guide](https://cformly.com/setup.html): three-step setup (app,
  extension, first filing) and the first filing, move by move.
- [Form III guide](https://cformly.com/form-c.html): what Form III is, the
  24-hour rule, who must file, and how the portal works.
- [FRRO portal registration guide](https://cformly.com/hotel-registration.html):
  how to create the accommodation account on the FRRO portal — what to
  prepare, what the form asks, and the FRRO-office fallback when it fails.
- [Photo compressor](https://cformly.com/compress.html): free client-side
  tool that shrinks a guest photo below the portal's 50 KB limit; runs
  entirely in the browser, no upload.
- [Browser extension](https://cformly.com/ext.html): how the fill works
  inside the host's own session; what the extension never does.
- [Privacy policy](https://cformly.com/privacy.html): DPDP Act 2023 notice —
  what is collected, where data is stored, guest rights.
- [Guest privacy badge](https://cformly.com/trust.html): printable reception
  card for foreign guests explaining what happens to their passport data.
- [Terms of service](https://cformly.com/terms.html): acceptance, host
  obligations, data accuracy, liability.
- [Security](https://cformly.com/.well-known/security.txt): security contact
  and policy.
